create.name: Sadie Barr
create.bio:
Sadie Barr is a coach and meditation teacher based in Bend, Oregon, who works mainly with women on what she calls self-trust: noticing their own thoughts and feelings, steadying themselves when things are uncertain, and acting from their own values rather than from a wish to please. She has spent more than ten years teaching yoga and meditation and leading workshops, retreats and coaching, and her training draws on yoga philosophy, applied mindfulness, polyvagal theory and theories of human development. She speaks openly about having rebuilt her own life from the inside, and that experience shapes how she works.

Her coaching runs over three months of weekly calls, each beginning with a short grounding practice in the body before turning to goals and practical next steps, with written prompts and small experiments to try between sessions. She frames her approach around six strands, from awareness and a felt sense of safety to self-worth, an inner compass, courageous action and daily embodied practice. On YouTube she has a set of short pranayama lessons, among them alternate nostril breathing, ujjayi and bhastrika, alongside brief talks on fear, belonging and the inner critic. Her Insight Timer library holds guided meditations, short video talks and a free community group.

courses.title: Self-Trust Coaching (Three Months, One to One)
courses.description: Three months of weekly one-to-one calls, opening with a 60-minute session and then 40-minute sessions that each start with a grounding practice before moving to goals and action steps. Text support is available between calls, and places are by application and a short introductory call.
courses.price: $550 USD a month, or $1,500 USD paid in full

free_resources.title: Sadie Barr on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided meditations and short video talks on self-trust, boundaries and keeping promises to yourself, plus a free community group she hosts. The single tracks are free to hear.

flags: Mainly a self-trust / life coach for women; the spiritual side is meditation, yoga breathing and mindfulness. Her site disclaimer calls her a Recovery Coach and Yoga Teacher.
All six of her Insight Timer courses and her Insight Timer group are built around 12-step recovery, sobriety and codependency, so none qualify; a human may want to judge whether the listing fits.
Her only paid offering is the coaching on her home page (no separate page; apply via a Google form), so the offering URL is the home page.
YouTube videos are short (2 to 5 minutes) and about three years old, with low view counts.
Third photo (laughing side view in a beanie) is from her own site and looks like her but is a profile shot; the first two are clearly the same person.
Insight Timer bio could only be partly quoted by WebFetch; bio check relied mainly on her own site pages.
left_out: Insight Timer courses: Deprogram From Limiting Beliefs In 12-Step Recovery, 7 Somatic Tools To Overcome Codependency, Facing Fear In Sobriety, Self-Care In Sobriety, The Body's Way Through The 12 Steps, 10 Mindful Tools For 12-Step Recovery (addiction recovery).
